subject: OptiShelf renewal: commit increase, burst pocket & term
messages:
From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@optishelf.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 06 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: OptiShelf renewal & commit increase — usage trend and ask

Hi Karthik,

Quick note as we prepare for our renewal: our platform usage has grown 3x since Q4 and our hosted API spend is outpacing forecasts. We currently have a 3,000,000 token/month committed tier (hosted API) with standard per-token overage. For planning and predictability we want to move to a larger committed tier and adjust rate bands to be more favorable.

What we're hoping for:
- A 10,000,000 token/month committed tier (or a guaranteed baseline of 9–11M tokens)
- A burst pocket (~2M tokens/month) for seasonal spikes
- A clearer soft-throttle window (95th percentile latency target + fallback behavior)
- Preferential pricing on the per-1k token rate (we're targeting ~12% off list)
- An 18-month term to lock pricing while we scale

Attached: optishelf-usage-apr-qtr.csv (sample usage by route) and our renewal timeline. Can we hop on a 30-min call next week? We're aiming to finalize terms by April 20 to match our budget cycle.

Thanks,
Alyssa Morgan
Head of Platform, OptiShelf Inc
alyssa@optishelf.com
Attachment: optishelf-usage-apr-qtr.csv (text/csv, 84KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@optishelf.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 07 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiShelf renewal & commit increase — usage trend and ask

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the context and the CSV. Congrats on the growth.

We can definitely design a renewal that gives you predictability and better unit economics. A couple of options to consider (high level):

- Option A: 5M committed tokens/month + 5M burst buffer (billed as usage above commit at discounted rate)
  - Effective per-1k rate: $6.40 (≈10% off list)
  - 12-month term (standard)
- Option B: 10M committed tokens/month + 2M burst pocket
  - Effective per-1k rate: $5.80 (≈15% off list)
  - 18-month term available with a 12% uplift discount
- Option C: Dedicated reserved pool (if you need isolation) — requires procurement and minimum SLA uplift

Operational notes:
- We can add a soft-throttle clause: gradual request shedding after 95th percentile latency target is violated for a rolling 5-minute window. We'll provide a per-route latency dashboard and token-level tracing during RTO.
- Bursts can be configured as monthly pockets or as temporary burst credits for seasonality — we'll recommend monthly pocket for predictability.

I'm attaching a short draft amendment that outlines the Option B pricing and draft clause language for soft-throttle and burst handling.

Proposed next steps:
1) Quick call Monday or Tuesday (I can do Mon 4/10 2–4pm PT)
2) Confirm preferred option and procurement lead
3) We'll send a DocuSign-ready amendment for signature

Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: draft-amendment-opti-2028.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 42KB)

From: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@optishelf.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Finance <procure@optishelf.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Apr 2028 08:56:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiShelf renewal & commit increase — usage trend and ask

Karthik — thanks. Option B looks closest to our needs. A few clarifications and asks before we lock:

- We can commit to 10M/month for 18 months if we get a 15% discount off the list effective rate and a 2.0M monthly burst pocket.
- Can we add a clause that allows a single mid-term uplift after 9 months (to re-evaluate and increase commit) without penalty?
- Our procurement team needs net-45 payment terms and a single consolidated invoice monthly.

Call: let's do Mon 4/10 at 3pm PT — you said 2–4pm; I'm available at 3pm. I'll include our procurement lead on the call.

Attached: optishelf-business-case.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)

On Mon, Apr 10, 2028 at 15:00 Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com> wrote:
> Thanks — joining the 3pm slot.

Alyssa
Head of Platform, OptiShelf Inc
Attachment: optishelf-business-case.pdf (application/pdf, 210KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Alyssa Morgan <alyssa@optishelf.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek@redwood.com>, Finance Ops <billing@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Apr 2028 15:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OptiShelf renewal & commit increase — usage trend and ask

Alyssa — great sync today. Summary of what we agreed on the call and next steps:

Agreed commercial terms:
- 10,000,000 tokens/month committed (hosted API)
- 2,000,000 tokens/month burst pocket
- 18-month term starting May 1, 2028
- 12% discount off published per-1k rates (final pricing in amendment)
- One mid-term uplift allowed at month 9 with no penalty (mutual written confirmation)
- Net-45 payment terms (billing to be consolidated monthly)

Operational notes:
- Soft-throttle behavior: graceful shedding after sustained latency breach; Redwood will provide per-route dashboards and token-level traces for troubleshooting.
- We will provision monitoring alerts for your SRE team and assign a CS lead during the first 30 days.

Next steps:
1) I'll circulate a DocuSign amendment (link below) with the 12% discount and the agreed clauses.
2) Billing will open a consolidated invoice to procure@optishelf.com on the first invoice cycle after May 1.
3) Please confirm the procurement contact; we've tentatively listed: Finance <procure@optishelf.com>.
